data.title: XMAX Enters Corporate Guarantee Agreement for DSH Obligations
data.description:
XMAX ( (XMAX) ) has provided an announcement.

On November 17, 2026, XMax Inc. entered into a corporate guarantee agreement with KT and DSH for KT’s benefit, following approval by XMax’s board. The guarantee covered certain unpaid DSH obligations under the upstream agreement, including eligible monthly charges, specified termination penalties and related costs, with principal recovery limited to KRW 155,012,298,700, approximately US$117 million, plus applicable interest and taxes.

The guarantee excluded DSH liabilities unrelated to qualifying XMax defaults and required payment within 30 days of a complying demand after seven days of nonpayment. It terminates 12 months after expiry or termination of the upstream agreement, except for conforming demands made before that date.

data.title: Ready Capital Announces One-for-Ten Reverse Stock Split
data.description:
Ready Capital ( (RC) ) has shared an update.

Ready Capital, a multi-strategy real estate finance company, announced on November 23, 2026, that its Board of Directors had approved a one-for-ten reverse stock split without stockholder approval. Scheduled to take effect at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 7, the split will reduce approximately 159.1 million outstanding common shares to approximately 15.9 million and authorized shares from 500 million to 50 million.

The reverse split will apply uniformly and will not affect stockholders’ ownership percentages, apart from de minimis changes from cash payments for fractional shares. Conversion and change-of-control provisions for the Series C and Series E preferred stock will be adjusted proportionately, while their outstanding share counts, liquidation preferences and dividend rates will remain unchanged.

data.title: Lumentum Holdings Reports Results of 2026 Annual Stockholders Meeting
data.description:

The meeting also included a proposal to ratify Deloitte & Touche LLP as the company’s independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending July 3, 2027. That proposal received 73,303,895 votes for, 419,377 against and 538,065 abstentions.

data.title: SL Science Holding Files Notice for December Extraordinary Meeting
data.description:

data.title: ICZOOM Group Receives Additional Nasdaq Notice Over Delinquent Annual Report
data.description:
ICZOOM Group, Inc. Class A ( (IZM) ) has provided an announcement.

ICZOOM Group Inc. operates a B2B e-commerce platform selling electronic components primarily to customers in Hong Kong and mainland China. Its customers are China-based SMEs in consumer electronics, IoT, automotive electronics and industry control, and it also provides temporary warehousing, logistics and shipping, and customs-clearance services.

On November 20, 2026, ICZOOM received an additional written Nasdaq notification that it was out of compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) because its Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, remained unfiled. The notice had no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the company’s securities.

The company was required to submit an updated compliance plan by December 7, 2026, while Nasdaq said any additional exception for regaining compliance with delinquent filings would be limited to a maximum of 180 calendar days from the interim report’s due date, December 28, 2026. If compliance is not restored by then, Nasdaq may issue a delisting determination, and the company could request a hearing.

data.description:

data.title: Alaska Silver Announces Executive Chair Employment Agreement
data.description:
An announcement from Alaska Silver Corp ( (TSE:WAM) ) is now available.

On November 20, 2026, Alaska Silver Corp. entered into a part-time executive employment agreement with Christopher “Kit” Marrs, effective retroactively to October 1, 2026, under which he continued as executive chair after ceasing as president and CEO on that date. The agreement superseded his prior employment arrangements and provided for reporting to the board.

Terms set a $139,375 annual base salary, a 10% payment in lieu of benefits, eligibility for a 70% annual target bonus subject to performance criteria, and participation in long-term incentive plans. If the company terminated Marrs without cause or he resigned for good reason, he was entitled to specified accrued compensation, bonus, incentive vesting and severance benefits; other termination circumstances provided only accrued compensation.

data.title: Life360 Leadership Transition as Hulls Retires, Goines Named Chair

The company said Hulls would remain a Class III director and, from January 1, 2027, serve as Co-Founder and Senior Adviser while continuing work with its AI Labs efforts.

Hulls’s transition agreement maintained his current salary through the transition date and set a $515,000 annual salary plus a 2027 annual bonus opportunity equal to 75% of base salary for his advisory role, subject to performance goals; it also provided specified continued pay and equity treatment if his employment ended under stated conditions.

data.title: Graham Expands Materials Processing Business Through Hauschild Acquisition
data.description:
Graham ( (GHM) ) has provided an update.

On November 23, 2026, Graham Corporation announced it had acquired 100% of Hauschild GmbH & Co. KG and Hauschild SpeedMixer GmbH, the parent of Hauschild SpeedMixer Inc., for approximately 12 times Hauschild’s Adjusted EBITDA. The all-cash purchase was funded entirely with cash on hand.

data.title: Ferrari Reports Latest Share Buyback Transactions
data.description:
Ferrari ( (IT:RACE) ) has provided an announcement.

On November 23, 2026, Ferrari N.V. reported buying 47,100 common shares on Euronext Milan between November 16 and 20 for €17,247,768.35, at an average €366.1947 per share. The purchases were made under the €250 million third tranche announced on September 1, 2026, within a multi-year buyback program of approximately €3.5 billion expected to be executed by 2030.

By November 20, the third tranche had totaled €160,718,067.86 for 452,561 shares on Euronext Milan and $38,897,666.60 (€34,123,943.35) for 95,801 shares on the NYSE. Since January 5, 2026, Ferrari had bought 2,249,546 own common shares, including Sell to Cover transactions, for €705,599,316.42, and held 2,139,166 treasury shares, equal to 1.21% of issued common shares net of incentive-plan assignments.
